text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking through town on a day off, when I happen to hear a cheerful voice calling out from a Chinese restaurant down the road.

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: Come on in, folks! Our grand eating contest is finally about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: Our hungry contestants are once again drooling at the prospect of seizing the throne today!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: Introducing our three-time undefeated champion, the Stomach Bulldozer of Hokkaido, Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: HAHAHA! That's me, the Bulldozer! I love mapo rice bowls! OH YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: H-huh?! Trainer, what are you doing here?!
choice_data_list: When did you become a reigning champion here?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Th-this isn't what it looks like! This just sort of… happened!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: They were, uh, having an eating contest when I passed by here a while back…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I got curious, so I signed up and ended up winning… And I've sort of been defending my title ever since…
choice_data_list: This isn't exactly fit for an athlete's diet, you know.
This isn't exactly fit for an athlete's diet, you know.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I know! But… I'm the reigning champion! I can't let people down!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: C'mon, champion! Show us your stuff today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Okay! Um.. Hahahahaha! It's chow time! YEAH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-well, no, actually the restaurant owner asked me to come up with a fun persona, so…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Please, Trainer! Just let me participate in this one last time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'll step down as champion after today, promise!
choice_data_list: …Then you'd better go out with a bang.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Listen up, fans and foodies! I know this is sudden, but after today's contest, I will be stepping down as champion!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: What?! Is she yankin' our chains here?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The champion just spoke normally!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Which is why today, I'm going to eat like there's no tomorrow and leave no room for regrets! YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week wins the contest in spectacular fashion, then steps down from her position, thus preserving her title as undefeated champion.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll do my best to only eat an appropriately-sized portion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week does her best while reining in her appetite, but with the other participants digging in with such gusto…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh. I lost…
choice_data_list: I guess you really did curb your appetite…
I guess you really did curb your appetite…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, it's better this way, actually. I knew I couldn't keep doing this, but I didn't feel like I could stop either…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Besides, my goal is to become the best racer in all of Japan, not the biggest eater! Let's get back to training! OH YEEEAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She might not have the title of champion anymore, but it doesn't look like her high-energy alter ego is going anywhere just yet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's wrong, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-what? Why are you talking like that?
choice_data_list: Show us your what your stomach's made of, champion! YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-okay! YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hahahahaha! I-I'm the Stomach Bulldozer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: True to her pseudonym, Special Week bulldozes through every dish put in front of her, and claims victory as the champion once more.
